item.title: Park Rx—Forest Bathing Walks 2026 — Sun Oct 25, 10:00 AM — Sugarloaf Ridge State Park
item.description: The practice of Forest Therapy has been shown to improve health and well-being. Have you heard about “Shinrin-yoku” or “forest bathing”? Here is an opportunity to take a walk and experience the practice for yourself. Learn techniques to maximize the health benefits and stress reducing qualities of this walking practice. Shinrin-yoku originated in Japan and is gaining popularity in the United States for its documented health benefits. This practice takes a walk in the woods to another level. A centering and calming restorative practice, it promotes balance and restored vitality through a quality of presence and heightened sensory awareness. Sugarloaf Ridge State Park hosts a Forest Therapy Series as part of its Park Rx Program the 4th Sunday of the month (March through November) led by certified Association of Nature and Forest Therapy (ANFT) practitioners.Tickets are $20 or free with a February 2026 or newer Park Rx from a Sonoma County Medical Provider. item.description:
Every Sunday: Free, live jazz every week performed by some of the best musicians in the SF Bay Area and beyond, right in the heart of downtown Petaluma! Every Sunday from 1 to 3:30, local jazz bassist and music book publisher Chuck Sher presents a rotating ensemble of professional, veteran jazz musicians in Putnam Plaza Park, right next to the Speakeasy. This event started in 2020 and has since become a staple for locals and visitors alike. Stop by and enjoy some of the best jazz the Bay Area has to offer!

item.title: Magdalena Open House: Walk Through a New Home You Can Lease and Buy — Thu Oct 29, 6:00 PM — Magdalena Home
item.description:
Come walk through a Magdalena home in Santa Rosa and see what life in a new factory-built home feels like: high ceilings, big windows, a full kitchen, a full bathroom with a modern shower, a washer/dryer and a sleeping loft.
Magdalena homes sit on wheels, so they can be towed to a backyard, family land or your own lot. Lease one for $980 a month plus site fee, live in it first, and buy it later at a locked price of $68,000 if it's right for you.
The open house is for reservation holders. Reserve a spot for $100, refundable anytime, at magdalena.one and we'll send you the address.
Source: Press Democrat

A movement-based strength training class designed to build functional strength, sculpt and tone muscles, and deepen your mind-body connection. All levels and body types welcome! Modifications are available, and no dance experience is necessary.
Bring your own resistance bands or light dumbbells if you have them. No equipment required!

item.title: The Joni Mitchell Situation — Sat Nov 7, 5:30 PM — Furthermore Wine and Music Lounge
item.description:
Follow the blustery autumn breeze into Furthermore Wine and Music Lounge on Sat., Nov. 7, 5:30-8:30 for a well-earned post-election kickback AND the Situation's Joni Mitchell birthday concert!
The Joni Mitchell Situation (Kate Foley-Beining, vocals, guitar, piano, dulcimer; Tom Shader, bass; Kevin Dillon, drums; and Christian Foley-Beining, guitar) will warm you up with a collection of Joni's most beloved inclement weather songs: Rainy Night House, Hunter, Urge for Going, Blue Motel Room, Hejira, River, and more.
We'll have balloons!
Enjoy a free three hour concert while you bask in Furthermore's cool urban vibe and savor their delicious wines or non-alcohol drink. Carry-in dinner is welcome, too.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Body Sculpt with Abigail — Sun Nov 8, 10:00 AM — Salsa Dance Marin
item.description:
Body Sculpt | Strength & Movement
A movement-based strength training class designed to build functional strength, sculpt and tone muscles, and deepen your mind-body connection. With an emphasis on core stability, lower-body strength, balance, and mobility, this class supports dancers and anyone looking to feel stronger and more connected to their body.
All levels and body types welcome! Modifications are available, and no dance experience is necessary.
Bring your own resistance bands or light dumbbells if you have them. No equipment required!
DATE: Sunday 10:00 am
Adress: 4140 Redwood Hwy 8, San Rafael
Teacher: Abigail Celestino
Source: North Bay Bohemian
